Hi Marissa,

Thanks again for agreeing to co-host the Nov 18 workshop with us. We had a quick ops ask: can Redwood provide a pool of 1,000 14-day trial vouchers (unique codes) that we can distribute to registrants and promo partners?

- 1,000 unique trial codes valid for 14 days from activation

- We may request a 200-code topup after the first day if attendance is higher than expected

Sarah —

Thanks for the clear spec. We can absolutely do 1,000 unique 14-day trial vouchers and deliver a CSV by Nov 12. A few quick notes / asks so ops can build the bundle correctly:

1) Do you want codes to be single-use (one account) or multi-use for shared teams? Our default for promo codes is single-use.
2) Which redemption URL would you like embedded — the standard sign-up flow or a dedicated campaign landing page?
3) Please confirm the timezone for expiry enforcement (we'll use UTC by default).

Implementation plan I propose:
- Nov 03: Redwood creates code pool + test sample (10 codes) and shares for QA
- Nov 12: Final CSV delivered to events@novaresearch.com and uploaded to shared Drive link
- Nov 18: Codes active for redemption; 200-code on-demand topup approved by default (no additional SOW for first topup)

Ben & Laura — pinging you for quota approval and ops ETA. If all clear, I'll confirm to Sarah and kick off the provisioning.

Thanks,
